name: zinterp_context_destroy
description: zInterp_Context::Destroy releases parser-owned macro, variable, include-frame, archive-search, scroll-list, and pointer-array state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja renders the scroll-always sentinel-list loop condition as a VC sete/neg/sbb/inc idiom; source uses the equivalent while (node != head) shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c0f70 validates calling ClearMacroTable, ClearVarTable, ClearFileFrameStack, freeing archiveSearchList through zUtil_ZRDR_FreeSearchPathList, clearing scrollAlwaysDriverNode, unlinking and deleting each scroll-always node until the sentinel is reached, freeing ptrArrayHead, clearing ptrArrayCount, and clearing includeDepth.

The native smoke verifies all owned tables are cleared, the archive search path is released, the scroll sentinel is restored with count zero, ptrArrayHead/ptrArrayCount/includeDepth are cleared, and conditionalDepth is left untouched.
